analysis: The PR changes docs/provider/cli-reference.md in two places: the 'Last updated' date bump (line 3) and the source-path reference for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED (line 1816). It moves from libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/GatedDelta.swift to libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLMCommon/GatedDelta.swift. The changed lines 3 and 1816 are outside the displayed base ranges, so they were verified from the patch excerpt only. I found no impact on the threat model assets or boundaries (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, T-041 and others). The environment-variable description is unchanged: '0' keeps the stock Qwen GDN prompt kernel. The doc path correction presumably reflects a source file move elsewhere in the PR. That move is not in this batch, so I cannot verify it, and I have no evidence that it affects security. Remaining integration question: if the PR also moves GatedDelta.swift, confirm that the kernel/rollback env semantics are preserved. This is a performance toggle with no demonstrated security relevance.
